*We may ask for your ID at the reception desk on the day of the event. If the information on your ID is different from the information on your "BANDAI TCG+" account, you will not be allowed to participate in the tournament. In such cases, all rights to participate in the tournament and to purchase prizes and goods will be forfeited. Please understand this beforehand.

*The video footage, photographs, and content of interviews may be used on the day of the event and at a later date on the official website, in magazine articles, on flyers, in video distribution, and in other media.
*Participation rights are non-transferable.

*Players who require guardianship or care may be permitted to bring a companion under special circumstances. Please inform a staff member at the venue. Companions are not permitted to participate in the tournament or purchase merchandise. Depending on the number of attendees, entry may not be permitted.

*Players cannot participate in a Last Chance Qualifier if they have the invitation to the Finals of the same game. If you have already purchased an LCQ ticket, please contact the organizer from the purchase details.
*Due to the venue's capacity for everyone's safety, entry may be restricted at times so you may need to wait to enter.
*For the Event Commemorative Items that were purchased when you purchased :
Items must be picked up onsite during event registration at BANDAI CARD GAMES Fest 26-27 in LONDON by EOC on Saturday Jan. 17th.
In order to pick-up your retail items, you must bring:
• Valid photo ID
• Order confirmation/barcode
Items must be picked up in person by the purchaser. Proxy pickup (friends, family, etc.) will not be allowed.
By purchasing, you acknowledge:
• You are able to attend the event in person and pick up your order onsite, there is no shipping.
• Orders not picked up in person by the close of event day will be canceled without refund.
• This package is only available during the event ticket purchase window.
• Purchase limits apply: limit 1 per item while supplies last.
What is Bandai TCG+?
TCG+ is a one-stop application for Bandai Card Games that includes finding a store near to you, registering for events, tournament attendance and pairings, deck building features, and statistics.
